prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Benin
Primary request: The Royal Palaces of Abomey, a traditional low earthen royal compound and courtyards.
Subject: Recognizable long low ochre-red cob and laterite walls enclosing an open courtyard, simple rectangular gateways and single-storey palace buildings with modest sloping roofs and timber veranda supports; small coloured figurative bas-relief wall panels, rendered as visual motifs without lettering.
Scene/backdrop: Warm reddish earth courtyard, a few leafy trees and modest grassy edges under blue sky. Emphasize the traditional Aja-Fon earthen compound, human-scale architecture and courtyards.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable traditional materials and geometry, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Broad slightly elevated courtyard view; important low walls, gateway and buildings comfortably inside central 75% width and height with breathing room.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, quiet and welcoming.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No European palace, giant stone castle, domed mosque, high towers, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected: low ochre and red earthen compound, open courtyards, single-storey veranda buildings, timber supports and straw-like sloping roofs. Figurative wall decorations and a few small visitors provide cultural detail. Relief motifs are illustrative rather than exact reproductions of historic panels. No European palace towers, readable text, flags, UI or logos.
